title: Organic Origins (Hydrocarbons to Amides)
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: The starting point for CHEM 3B organic chemistry: spot, name, and draw organic compounds, then predict how they react. Seven modes: Spot the Group, 1°/2°/3° classification, Name It, Draw It, Predict the Product, Properties, and Med Molecules (spot labeled groups in 103 real drugs, biomolecules and benzene derivatives, with nursing, dental, anesthesia, imaging and A&P fun facts). Covers the CHEM 3B organic chapters from hydrocarbons through amides, with skeletal, condensed, or mixed structure styles. Includes hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, achievement badges, and a Dr. Dan CHEM 3B video playlist.
